references.text: Verse 10 confirms and summarizes the relationship between Ada/Basmat and their sons Eliphaz/Reuel as introduced in verse 4.
Verse 12 expands on Eliphaz's line (mentioned in verse 4) by listing his sons and confirming Ada as the mother.
Verse 13 confirms Basmat as the mother of Reuel (mentioned in verse 4) and details his descendants.
Verse 5 confirms Eliphaz and Reuel as Esau's sons (as in verse 4) and expands the list with additional brothers.
